messages:
jordan: Heads up — customer StormCap reporting p99 spikes on embedding requests since 03:15 UTC. SLA at risk. Logs show KV cache miss rate jumped. Can we get owners + immediate mitigation plan?

alex: On it. I've queued a METRIC alert and started a perf trace. tagging @maria for routing and @sam for fallback/model changes.

maria: @alex can we short-term route StormCap traffic to dedicated pool `dedicated-2`? Should be safe for a short burst, capacity ok but need infra approval.

sam: We can route + prepare fallback to quantized model `grok-small-q4` for long requests (>1024 tokens). Quality delta small but lowers CPU. I can own fallback config.

alex: Prefer routing first. maria — can you run the routing patch once infra signs off? I opened a PR to add a canary route: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 (code review ping @sree)

maria: Pinging infra for burst quota now, ETA ~12m. Once allocated I'll run the patch: `kubectl patch svc routing -p '{"spec":{"rules":[{"host":"stormcap","backend":"dedicated-2"}]}}'`.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2024-4567 — status: investigating.

jordan: If we route, need a rollback plan if dedicated pool saturates. Proposal: route -> monitor 15m -> if p99 not down, enable fallback to `grok-small-q4` + 5% progressive throttle on tail requests. Who owns rollback ops?

sam: I'll own rollback and fallback toggles. I'll stage config in prod-canary and then flip. ETA ~30m to full config and tests. Will post diffs when ready.

alex: Code review ping @sree for PR 1234, and @ops for dedicated pool quota confirmation. Also add a short note to the runbook about this temporary route.

sree: Reviewing PR now, two tiny comments on route tests — will approve in ~10m after fixes.

ops-bot: Dedicated pool allocation succeeded: `dedicated-2` (instance id x-789).

maria: Routing patched to `dedicated-2`. Monitoring dashboard: p99 dropping from 980ms -> 140ms. Keeping watch for 1h. :thumbsup:

jordan: Thanks everyone. I'll update CS and execs (brief summary + next steps). Reopen thread if regressions. Closing loop after 1h stable.
